description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Rocket is a Detroit-based company that provides digital solutions for complex transactions across industries including mortgages, fintech, and real estate. The company is seeking a Software Engineer I to build and maintain client-facing and team member-facing servicing applications across the front end and back end. The role includes feature development, testing, code reviews, cloud deployment, bug resolution, documentation, and AI-assisted engineering.
Full-stack software engineer building, testing, deploying, and supporting web applications

Responsibilities:
• Code and maintain high-quality full-stack software solutions with guidance from senior engineers
• Build new features and improve existing functionality across the front end (Next.js or React) and back end (.NET / C#, NestJS GraphQL)
• Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and implement product requirements
• Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
• Write and maintain automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of our applications
• Deploy and support applications on AWS and Amazon EKS through CI/CD pipelines
• Identify and resolve bugs and issues in a timely manner
• Use AI code generation tools such as GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as part of your daily workflow
• Create and maintain clear, concise documentation for code, APIs, and systems
• This role may include participation in an on-call rotation to support production systems and ensure service reliability. On-call responsibilities may include coverage during nights and weekends. If applicable, frequency and scheduling will be determined by team needs and communicated accordingly

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of professional experience in software development
• Exposure to at least one modern front-end framework such as Next.js or React
• Exposure to back-end development with .NET / C# and/or NestJS GraphQL
• Experience with, or willingness to learn, GraphQL integration layers and API development
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) and containerized deployments (Amazon EKS / Kubernetes), or eagerness to learn
• Understanding of CI/CD concepts and automated testing
• Experience using AI code generation tools such as GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude Code, Cursor, or similar
• Strong understanding of software development principles and practices
• Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work independently and as part of a team
